scope: Local compilation of packages/cre/workflow.ts to WASM with two independent toolchains. Not a simulation, not confidential execution, not a deployment.
fix: workflow.ts previously exported onPrivateSize(runtime, payload) and initWorkflow(config). cre-compile maps module exports to WASM exports and Javy fails with 'Exported functions with parameters are not supported'. Both are now module-private; only the zero-argument main() is exported, matching the SDK wrapper contract.

creCliBuild.command: cre workflow build packages/cre -R packages/cre --target staging-settings --non-interactive
creCliBuild.reproducible: Identical hash from independent build invocations on host.

creCliHash.note: The --public_key is the simulation placeholder, not a real workflow owner. The hash subcommand performs its own compile and reported a different binary hash than the build subcommand; both are recorded as observed and were not reconciled.

simulation.command: cre workflow simulate packages/cre -R packages/cre --target staging-settings --non-interactive --http-payload {"requestedSize":"1000"} --trigger-index 0
simulation.reason: CRE CLI v1.32.0 requires `cre login` or CRE_API_KEY before simulating. No credentials exist in this environment and none were requested. `cre init` is gated the same way.
simulation.expectedWhenUnblocked: The staging callbackUrl (bridge.example.com) is unreachable by design, so a simulation will clip inside the handler and then throw 'Confidential result callback was not acknowledged.' A full end-to-end result needs a reachable HTTPS bridge on an approved public DNS name plus confidential-workflow access.
